name: Marigold
blurb: A hardy border flower that shrugs off a missed day.

name: Cosmos
blurb: Tall and airy; sways at the slightest breeze.

name: Chamomile
blurb: Small white daisies that smell of warm apples.

name: Tulip
blurb: One clean cup on one clean stem.

name: Bluebell
blurb: Nodding bells that ring for nobody.

name: Strawberry
blurb: Runners everywhere; fruit if you keep walking.

name: Tomato
blurb: A vine that wants a stake and a long summer.

name: Basil
blurb: Pinch the tips and it thickens.

name: Mint
blurb: Give it a pot or it takes the whole bed.

name: Lavender
blurb: Grey-green spikes; the bees find it first.

name: Poppy
blurb: Paper petals on a hairy stem.

name: Snapdragon
blurb: Squeeze a flower and it opens its jaw.

name: Sunflower
blurb: Follows the light all day and sleeps facing east.

name: Morning Glory
blurb: Opens at dawn and is done by lunch.

name: Dahlia
blurb: A hundred petals wound into a sphere.

name: Wisteria
blurb: Waterfalls of bloom on old wood.
